limitations: Synthetic warm exact-query measurements; no embedding or generation provider latency.
The host also serves application traffic; production load was not controlled.
GPU and CPU clocks and scheduling vary. The unchanged small CPU control also varies; do not attribute its changes to GPU pipelining.
100k single-query median regresses; workload-specific measurements are not a universal optimum.
Cache must hold each scored column; this is not out-of-core or ten-million-document validation.
